item.title: BenchMIRT: What are LLM benchmarks actually measuring?
item.description: BenchMIRT is a new method for auditing LLM benchmarks question by question, revealing which capabilities they actually measure and helping researchers build smaller, more focused, and easier-to-interpret evaluations.
